calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25'

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as distinct_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25'

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as all_versions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current = true THEN member_id END) as current_only
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25'

SELECT 
  is_current,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY is_current

SELECT 
  join_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN '2026-09-23' AND '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY join_date
ORDER BY join_date
